chapter: With Chick Webb and Ella Fitzgerald, 1936-39
title: Band personnel on McRae's arrival: brass and reeds
summary: Welburn and McRae go through trumpets, trombones (Nat Story, Sandy Williams) and the reed section including Wayman Carver.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
